name: NGC 2814, SN 2020mmz field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2814, a nearly edge-on spiral galaxy that hosted the supernova SN 2020mmz, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2020mmzhost-hubble
story: SN 2020mmz, a Type II-L supernova, exploded in this nearly edge-on spiral and faded unusually fast in the weeks after its peak. Hubble came back to study the stars around the explosion site and learn about the star that died.

claims.text: NGC 2814 is the host galaxy of SN 2020mmz
SN 2020mmz lies in a nearly edge-on spiral galaxy
SN 2020mmz is a Type II-L supernova
SN 2020mmz declined in brightness fast for the first 20 days after maximum
SN2020MMZ is a target of Hubble program 17070, which resolves the stars around Type II supernovae to estimate progenitor masses
